However, Busby retired long before recruiting Beckham (who joined in 1992). The Agent failed to verify that the search snippet was answering the wrong question (tenure) rather than the specific recruiting event, leading to a hallucinated fact. If this check had passed, the Planner would have rejected the assumption and re-framed the query.
